parts.zh: M: 嘿，我刚读了一本很棒的物理学书
M: 而且，在一个传统上由男性主导的领域里
W: 我喜欢这本书清晰易懂的写法
M: 是啊，我喜欢她通过提供大量自己动手做的实验来培养科学参与感
是的。我得说，这本没有公式的书非常适合各个领域的科学家
M：哦，对。他是那个写过关于我们的美感观念从何而来的哲学家
W：没错。我建议你去图书馆找一本他的传记
M：太好了！教授，谢谢您抽时间回答我的问题
W：如果你还需要其他帮助

items.stem: What does the woman say about the book the man recommended?

choices.text: It can benefit professionals and non-professionals alike.
choices.zh: 它对专业人士和非专业人士都同样有益。

choices.text: It lists the various challenges physicists are confronting.
choices.zh: 它列出了物理学家们正面临的各种挑战。

choices.text: It describes how some mysteries of physics were solved.
choices.zh: 它描述了物理学的一些谜团是如何被解开的。

choices.text: It is one of the most fascinating physics books ever written.
choices.zh: 它是有史以来最引人入胜的物理学书籍之一。

items.stem: What can we find in the book the man recommended?

choices.text: Physicists' contribution to humanity.
choices.zh: 物理学家对人类的贡献。

choices.text: Stories about some female physicists.
choices.zh: 关于一些女性物理学家的故事。

choices.text: Historical evolution of modern physics.
choices.zh: 现代物理学的历史演变。

choices.text: Women's changing attitudes to physics.
choices.zh: 女性对物理学态度的变化。

items.stem: How does the author bring her book to life?

choices.text: By exposing a lot of myths in physics.
choices.zh: 通过揭露物理学中的许多误解。

choices.text: By describing her own life experiences.
choices.zh: 通过描述她自己的生活经历。

choices.text: By including lots of fascinating knowledge.
choices.zh: 通过包含大量引人入胜的知识。

choices.text: By telling anecdotes about famous professors.
choices.zh: 通过讲述关于著名教授的趣闻轶事。

items.stem: How does the book cultivate readers' interest in physics?

choices.text: It avoids detailing abstract concepts of physics.
choices.zh: 它避免详细阐述物理学的抽象概念。

choices.text: It contains a lot of thought-provoking questions.
choices.zh: 它包含大量引人思考的问题。

choices.text: It demonstrates how they can become physicists.
choices.zh: 它展示了他们如何能够成为物理学家。

choices.text: It provides experiments they can do themselves.
choices.zh: 它提供了他们可以自己动手做的实验。

items.stem: What is the man's problem?

choices.text: He is too busy to finish his assignment in time.
choices.zh: 他太忙了,无法按时完成作业。

choices.text: He does not know what kind of topic to write on.
choices.zh: 他不知道该写什么样的主题。

choices.text: He does not understand the professor's instructions.
choices.zh: 他不理解教授的指示。

choices.text: He has no idea how to proceed with his dissertation.
choices.zh: 他不知道如何着手写论文。

items.stem: What does the professor think of the man's topic?

choices.text: It is too broad.
choices.zh: 太宽泛了。

choices.text: It is a bit outdated.
choices.zh: 有点过时了。

choices.text: It is challenging.
choices.zh: 有挑战性。

choices.text: It is interesting.
choices.zh: 很有趣。

items.stem: What is the man really more interested in?

choices.text: Biography.
choices.zh: 传记。

choices.text: Nature.
choices.zh: 自然。

choices.text: Philosophy.
choices.zh: 哲学。

choices.text: Beauty.
choices.zh: 美。

items.stem: What does the professor say the man has to do?

choices.text: Improve his cumulative grade.
choices.zh: 提高他的累计成绩。

choices.text: Develop his reading ability.
choices.zh: 培养他的阅读能力。

choices.text: Stick to the topic assigned.
choices.zh: 坚持布置的主题。

choices.text: List the parameters first.
choices.zh: 先列出参数。

items.stem: What did climate scientists describe as "stunning"?

choices.text: The unprecedented high temperature in Greenland.
choices.zh: 格陵兰岛前所未有的高温。

choices.text: The collapse of ice on the northern tip of Greenland.
choices.zh: 格陵兰岛北端冰层的崩塌。

choices.text: The unusual cold spell in the Arctic area in October.
choices.zh: 10月北极地区异常的寒潮。

choices.text: The rapid change of Arctic temperature within a day.
choices.zh: 北极气温在一天内的快速变化。

items.stem: What does the passage say about the temperature surge in the Arctic?

choices.text: It has created a totally new climate pattern.
choices.zh: 它创造了一种全新的气候模式。

choices.text: It will pose a serious threat to many species.
choices.zh: 它将对许多物种构成严重威胁。

choices.text: It typically appears about once every ten years.
choices.zh: 它通常大约每十年出现一次。

choices.text: It has puzzled the climate scientists for decades.
choices.zh: 它已经困扰了气候科学家几十年。

items.stem: What may occur in 20 years according to scientists' recent observations?

choices.text: Extinction of Arctic wildlife.
choices.zh: 北极野生动物的灭绝。

choices.text: Iceless summers in the Arctic.
choices.zh: 北极的无冰夏季。

choices.text: Emigration of indigenous people.
choices.zh: 原住民的迁徙。

choices.text: Better understanding of ecosystems.
choices.zh: 对生态系统更好的理解。

items.stem: What is often necessary for carrying through a task?

choices.text: A good start.
choices.zh: 一个良好的开端。

choices.text: A detailed plan.
choices.zh: 一个详细的计划。

choices.text: A strong determination.
choices.zh: 坚定的决心。

choices.text: A scientific approach.
choices.zh: 科学的方法。

items.stem: What is the finding of the new study?

choices.text: Most people get energized after a sufficient rest.
choices.zh: 大多数人在充分休息后会恢复精力。

choices.text: Most people tend to have a finite source of energy.
choices.zh: 大多数人往往拥有有限的能量来源。

choices.text: It is vital to take breaks between demanding mental tasks.
choices.zh: 在高强度脑力任务之间休息至关重要。

choices.text: It is most important to have confidence in one's willpower.
choices.zh: 对自己的意志力有信心最为重要。

items.stem: What do we learn about European participants as compared with their American counterparts?

choices.text: They could keep on working longer.
choices.zh: 他们能够持续工作更长时间。

choices.text: They could do more challenging tasks.
choices.zh: 他们能够完成更具挑战性的任务。

choices.text: They found it easier to focus on work at hand.
choices.zh: 他们发现更容易专注于手头的工作。

choices.text: They held more positive attitudes toward life.
choices.zh: 他们对生活持有更积极的态度。

items.stem: What do the researchers say concerning people's feelings about willpower?

choices.text: They are part of their nature.
choices.zh: 它们是人们天性的一部分。

choices.text: They are subject to change.
choices.zh: 它们会发生变化。

choices.text: They are related to culture.
choices.zh: 它们与文化相关。

choices.text: They are beyond control.
choices.zh: 它们无法控制。

items.stem: What did the researchers at Oxford University conclude?

choices.text: About half of current jobs might be automated.
choices.zh: 目前约半数工作可能会被自动化。

choices.text: The jobs of doctors and lawyers would be threatened.
choices.zh: 医生和律师的工作将受到威胁。

choices.text: The job market is becoming somewhat unpredictable.
choices.zh: 就业市场正变得有些难以预测。

choices.text: Machine learning would prove disruptive by 2013.
choices.zh: 机器学习将在2013年前证明具有颠覆性。

items.stem: What do we learn about Kaggle company's winning programs?

choices.text: They are widely applicable for massive open online courses.
choices.zh: 它们广泛适用于大规模开放在线课程。

choices.text: They are now being used by numerous high school teachers.
choices.zh: 它们现在正被众多高中教师使用。

choices.text: They could read as many as 10,000 essays in a single minute.
choices.zh: 它们能在一分钟内阅读多达10,000篇论文。

choices.text: They could grade high-school essays just like human teachers.
choices.zh: 它们能像人类教师一样给高中论文评分。

items.stem: What is the fundamental limitation of machine learning?

choices.text: It needs instructions throughout the process.
choices.zh: 它在整个过程中都需要指令。

choices.text: It does poorly on frequent, high-volume tasks.
choices.zh: 它在频繁、大量的任务上表现不佳。

choices.text: It has to rely on huge amounts of previous data.
choices.zh: 它必须依赖大量先前数据。

choices.text: It is slow when it comes to tracking novel things.
choices.zh: 它在追踪新事物时速度缓慢。

items.stem: What has the speaker previously talked about?

choices.text: The engineering problems with solar power.
choices.zh: 太阳能发电的工程问题。

choices.text: The generation of steam with the latest technology.
choices.zh: 用最新技术产生蒸汽。

choices.text: The importance of exploring new energy sources.
choices.zh: 探索新能源的重要性。

choices.text: The theoretical aspects of sustainable energy.
choices.zh: 可持续能源的理论方面。

items.stem: What is Tim Castleman trying to do in Sacramento?

choices.text: Drive trains with solar energy.
choices.zh: 用太阳能驱动火车。

choices.text: Upgrade the city's train facilities.
choices.zh: 升级该市的火车设施。

choices.text: Build a new ten-kilometre railway line.
choices.zh: 建造一条新的十公里铁路线。

choices.text: Cut down the city's energy consumption.
choices.zh: 削减该市的能源消耗。

items.stem: What has a Japanese research team tried to do?

choices.text: Build a tank for keeping calcium oxide.
choices.zh: 建造一个用于保存氧化钙的容器。

choices.text: Find a new material for storing energy.
choices.zh: 找到一种储存能量的新材料。

choices.text: Recover super-heated steam.
choices.zh: 回收过热蒸汽。

choices.text: Collect carbon dioxide gas.
choices.zh: 收集二氧化碳气体。

items.stem: What is one cause of the current crisis in care for the elderly in England?

choices.text: The lack of supervision by both the national and local governments.
choices.zh: 国家和地方政府缺乏监管。

choices.text: The impact of the current economic crisis at home and abroad.
choices.zh: 国内外当前经济危机的影响。

choices.text: The poor management of day centres and home help services.
choices.zh: 日间照料中心和家庭帮助服务的管理不善。

choices.text: The poor relation between national health and social care services.
choices.zh: 国家医疗服务与社会护理服务之间的关系不佳。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about residential and community care?

choices.text: It was mainly provided by voluntary services.
choices.zh: 它主要由志愿服务提供。

choices.text: It mainly caters to the needs of the privileged.
choices.zh: 它主要满足特权阶层的需求。

choices.text: It called for a sufficient number of volunteers.
choices.zh: 它需要足够数量的志愿者。

choices.text: It has deteriorated over the past sixty years.
choices.zh: 在过去六十年里它已经恶化了。

items.stem: What made management of care for the elderly more difficult in the 1980s?

choices.text: Their longer lifespans.
choices.zh: 他们更长的寿命。

choices.text: Fewer home helpers available.
choices.zh: 可用的家庭帮助人员更少。

choices.text: Their preference for private services.
choices.zh: 他们对私人服务的偏好。

choices.text: More of them suffering serious illnesses.
choices.zh: 他们中更多人患有严重疾病。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about older people in England?

choices.text: They are unable to pay for health services.
choices.zh: 他们无力支付医疗服务费用。

choices.text: They have long been discriminated against.
choices.zh: 他们长期以来一直受到歧视。

choices.text: They are vulnerable to illnesses and diseases.
choices.zh: 他们容易患病和疾病。

choices.text: They have contributed a great deal to society.
choices.zh: 他们为社会做出了巨大贡献。
